alt: RU-8 rendered as a hardware unit on a dark table, a band of light passing over its pads
line: Recorded kits join the synthesized ones. Every pad takes your own WAV or AIFF files, up to eight on one pad, played by chance. EDIT shows each pad's sound and the picture of every knob you turn, and HUMAN now plays like a drummer: the snare a little behind, lazy sixteenth hats, the time breathing. Every RU-8 owner gets it on the licence they already have.
title: RU-8 1.1: recorded kits, your own samples and an EDIT screen.
